Pedal Steel Noah at Hole In the Wall

Sep 23, 2026Sep 23, 2026 by Laurie Gallardo

The Austin Music Minute is supported by Howler Brothers, an Austin-based designer of creative outdoor apparel since 2011, and by Planet K, Austin’s local hemp emporium since 1990.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

You can count Peter Hook (New Order), Frank Black (Pixies), R.E.M., Neko Case and several other well-known artists as fans of this talented 18-year-old musician. Chances are he’s covered their music in unique and refreshing ways. That’s the magic of Pedal Steel Noah. Pedal steel player Noah Faulkner and his brother, bassist Nate Faulkner, continue impressing countless admirers with gorgeous covers of classic ’80s and ’90s favorites on their daily Instagram videos. In 2024, they were invited to play the Grand Ole Opry, where they were brought on stage by Vince Gill to cover a Buck Owens tune.

Perhaps you’ve seen them perform at Rock the Park, or out by Lady Bird Lack during SXSW. Now’s your chance to experience the artistry of Pedal Steel Noah up close at his residency show tonight at Hole In the Wall. Doors at 8 p.m., with the music starting at 9 p.m.
